import sys
sys.path.append('/path/to/tools')

from tools import search_flights, filter_flights, search_hotels, filter_hotels, search_restaurants, filter_restaurants, search_nearest, get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache

# Retrieve cached restaurant search results
restaurant_results = get_results_from_cache(key="previous_restaurants")

# Search for flights from Atlanta to St. Louis for both dates
flight_results = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Atlanta",
    end_airport_city="St. Louis",
    departure_date=["May 16, 2025", "May 22, 2025"],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Save flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="flights", value=flight_results)

# Filter flights by economy class
filtered_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=flight_results,
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Save filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_flights", value=filtered_flights)

# Search for hotels in Downtown St. Louis with free parking
hotel_results = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    neighborhood=["Downtown St. Louis"],
    checkin_date=["May 16, 2025", "May 22, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["May 25, 2025"],
    budget=70,
    free_wifi_included=True,
    free_parking=True
)

# Save hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotel_results)

# Filter hotels by free parking
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotel_results,
    free_parking=True
)

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Filter restaurants by Chinese cuisine and no dairy
filtered_restaurants = filter_restaurants(
    prior_results=restaurant_results,
    cuisine=["Chinese"],
    has_dairy_allergy_options=False
)

# Save filtered restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants", value=filtered_restaurants)

# Find nearest restaurants to the filtered hotels
nearest_restaurants = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    restaurants=filtered_restaurants,
    groupBy="restaurant"
)

# Save nearest restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_restaurants", value=nearest_restaurants)

print("No planning needed")
